verdict.rationale: Bento documents a public REST API with an endpoint reference browser, HTTP Basic key authentication, error-handling guidance, a Postman collection covering every endpoint, and concrete endpoints for subscribers, events, and broadcasts that let a programmatic or AI client drive the account. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented (community evidence does not mention the API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This browser gives you one place to scan Bento endpoints, request fields, response fields, and the matching hand-written docs.
Bento uses HTTP Basic authentication. Use your publishable key as the username and your secret key as the password.
Use this page to diagnose failed API calls.
covers every Bento API endpoint, so you can call the API directly from any language.
Track user activity, update profile fields, and trigger automations.
Use the API to review broadcast history, create campaigns, and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules.
